lore_summary: A creature of the Myth Eternal, aligned with Primordial energy. Known among tamers as a Giant-Kin-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Myth Eternal. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primordial tamers are called Myth-Speakers. Bond is formed through telling a worthy story — the tamer submits a narrative about the monster, judged by the creature itself.

base_chain.name: Newborn Zeus-Born Titan
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Zeus-Born Titan. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Myth Eternal. Zeus-Born Titans in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Rising Zeus-Born Titan
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primordial — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Myth Eternal. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Zeus-Born Titan
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Zeus-Born Titan bears the aesthetic of Myth Eternal — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primordial crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Myth Eternal. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

evolution_req.special: Clear  the world remembers being born. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Chosen Zeus-Born Titan
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Titan Born Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Myth Eternal, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Zeus-Born Titan — Titan Born Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Titan Born path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Titan Born Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Zeus-Born Titan is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Myth Eternal. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

star_6.name: Zeus-Born Titan the Last
star_6.appearance: Zeus-Born Titan now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Zeus-Born Titans have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

star_7.name: Origin Zeus-Born Titan
star_7.appearance: The final form. Zeus-Born Titan stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Zeus-Born Titan is reached only through the completion of the legendary "Before the First Word" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

base_chain.name: Spawn Ra's Ember

base_chain.name: Kindling Ra's Ember

lore_summary: A creature of the Myth Eternal, aligned with Primordial energy. Known among tamers as a Serpentine-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Myth Eternal. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primordial tamers are called Myth-Speakers. Bond is formed through telling a worthy story — the tamer submits a narrative about the monster, judged by the creature itself.

base_chain.name: Newborn Shiva Aspect
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Shiva Aspect. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Myth Eternal. Shiva Aspects in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: First-Form Shiva Aspect
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primordial — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Myth Eternal. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Shiva Aspect
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Shiva Aspect bears the aesthetic of Myth Eternal — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primordial crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Myth Eternal. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Newborn Black Tortoise Spawn
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Black Tortoise Spawn. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Myth Eternal. Black Tortoise Spawns in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Rising Black Tortoise Spawn

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.name: Stirring Kronos Fragment
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Kronos Fragments begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Kronos Fragment
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Kronos Fragments are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Forsaken Kronos Fragment
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.name: Fledgling Cerberus Pup I
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Cerberus Pup I. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Cerberus Pup I is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Rising Cerberus Pup I
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Cerberus Pup Is begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Cerberus Pup I
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Cerberus Pup Is are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

base_chain.name: Marked Cerberus Pup I
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Lernaean Hydras have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

star_7.name: Origin Lernaean Hydra
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Lernaean Hydra is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Lernaean Hydra is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Lernaean Hydra has never been fully documented. star_8.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Wisp Lernaean Hydra
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Lernaean Hydra. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Lernaean Hydra is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Awakened Lernaean Hydra
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Lernaean Hydras begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Lernaean Hydra
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Lernaean Hydras are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Crowned Lernaean Hydra
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Nemean Lions have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

star_7.name: Absolute Nemean Lion
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Nemean Lion is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Nemean Lion is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

star_8.name: Nemean Lion: The Undying
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Nemean Lion at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Nemean Lion has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

base_chain.name: Pup Nemean Lion
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Nemean Lion. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Nemean Lion is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: Awakened Nemean Lion
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Nemean Lions begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Nemean Lion
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Nemean Lions are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Crowned Nemean Lion
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: Spawn Cyclops Youngling
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Cyclops Youngling. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Cyclops Youngling is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Nascent Cyclops Youngling
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Cyclops Younglings begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Cyclops Youngling
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Cyclops Younglings are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Marked Cyclops Youngling
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Cyclops Elders begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Cyclops Elder
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Cyclops Elders are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: Exalted Cyclops Elder
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

star_5.name: Polyphemus Echo — Titan Born Hegemon
star_5.appearance: The Titan Born path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Titan Born path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Polyphemus Echos are landmarks. Myth Eternal merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. star_5.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

star_6.name: Polyphemus Echo the Ancient
star_6.appearance: Polyphemus Echo defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Polyphemus Echos have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

star_7.name: Eternal Polyphemus Echo

star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Polyphemus Echo is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Satyr Dancers are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Crowned Satyr Dancer
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

star_5.name: Satyr Elder — Titan Born Champion
star_5.appearance: The Titan Born path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Titan Born path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Satyr Elders are landmarks. Myth Eternal merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

star_6.name: Satyr Elder the Absolute
star_6.appearance: Satyr Elder defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Satyr Elders have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

star_7.name: Last Satyr Elder
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Satyr Elder is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Satyr Elder is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

star_8.name: Satyr Elder: First and Last
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Satyr Elder at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Satyr Elder has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.name: Awakened Scylla Minor
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Scylla Minors begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Scylla Minor
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Scylla Minors are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Exalted Scylla Minor
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. base_chain.name: Rising Dryad Sapling
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Dryad Saplings begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Dryad Sapling
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Dryad Saplings are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Ascendant Dryad Sapling
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.

base_chain.name: Young Naiad Current

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Naiad Current is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Nascent Naiad Current
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.

base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Naiad Current

base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Fledgling Triton Champion
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Triton Champion. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Triton Champion is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.name: Rising Triton Champion
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Triton Champions begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Triton Champion
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Triton Champions are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Marked Triton Champion
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Ares War Aspect. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Ares War Aspect is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.

base_chain.name: Stirring Ares War Aspect
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.

base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Ares War Aspect

star_6.name: Artemis Hunt Aspect the Ancient
star_6.appearance: Artemis Hunt Aspect defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Artemis Hunt Aspects have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

star_7.name: Last Artemis Hunt Aspect

base_chain.name: Wisp Artemis Hunt Aspect
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Artemis Hunt Aspect. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Artemis Hunt Aspect is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Stirring Artemis Hunt Aspect
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Artemis Hunt Aspects begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Artemis Hunt Aspect
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Artemis Hunt Aspects are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Branded Artemis Hunt Aspect
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Hermes Wing is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Awakened Hermes Wing
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Hermes Wings begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Hermes Wing
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Hermes Wings are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: Exalted Hermes Wing
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

star_5.name: Poseidon Wave — Titan Born Archon
star_5.appearance: The Titan Born path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Titan Born path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Poseidon Waves are landmarks. Myth Eternal merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

star_6.name: Poseidon Wave the True
star_6.appearance: Poseidon Wave defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Poseidon Waves have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

star_7.name: Absolute Poseidon Wave
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Poseidon Wave is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Poseidon Wave is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Poseidon Wave has never been fully documented. base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Thanatos Touchs begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: Thanatos Touch
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Thanatos Touchs are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Hallowed Thanatos Touch
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

star_5.name: Hypnos Veil — Titan Born Champion
star_5.appearance: The Titan Born path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Titan Born path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Hypnos Veils are landmarks. Myth Eternal merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

star_6.name: Hypnos Veil the True
star_6.appearance: Hypnos Veil defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Hypnos Veils have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

star_7.name: Final Hypnos Veil
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Hypnos Veil is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Hypnos Veil is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

star_8.name: Hypnos Veil: World-Soul
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Hypnos Veil at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Hypnos Veil has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Theseus Aspect
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Theseus Aspect. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Theseus Aspect is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Stirring Theseus Aspect
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Theseus Aspects begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Theseus Aspect
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Theseus Aspects are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Chosen Theseus Aspect
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Lesser Sisyphus Boulder

base_chain.name: Awakened Sisyphus Boulder

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Sisyphus Boulders begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: Sisyphus Boulder
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Sisyphus Boulders are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.name: Chosen Sisyphus Boulder

base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Young Argo's Echo
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Argo's Echo. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Argo's Echo is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.

base_chain.name: Emerging Argo's Echo
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Argo's Echos begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Argo's Echo
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Argo's Echos are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Crowned Argo's Echo
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Echo Spirit is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Kindling Echo Spirit
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Echo Spirits begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Echo Spirit
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Echo Spirits are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: Ascendant Echo Spirit
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

star_5.name: Calypso Isle — Titan Born Overlord
star_5.appearance: The Titan Born path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Titan Born path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Calypso Isles are landmarks. Myth Eternal merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

star_6.name: Calypso Isle the Eternal
star_6.appearance: Calypso Isle defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Calypso Isles have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

star_7.name: Apex Calypso Isle
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Calypso Isle is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Calypso Isle is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

star_8.name: Calypso Isle: World-Shaper
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Calypso Isle at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Calypso Isle has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.

base_chain.name: Seed Arachne Weaver
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Arachne Weaver. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Arachne Weaver is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Nascent Arachne Weaver
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Arachne Weavers begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Arachne Weaver
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Arachne Weavers are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: Ascendant Arachne Weaver
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks
