base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

star_5.name: Hera Queen Aspect — Titan Born Overlord
star_5.appearance: The Titan Born path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Titan Born path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.

star_5.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

star_6.name: Hera Queen Aspect the Boundless
star_6.appearance: Hera Queen Aspect defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Hera Queen Aspects have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

star_7.name: Apex Hera Queen Aspect
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Hera Queen Aspect is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Hera Queen Aspect is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.name: First-Form Hephaestus God Forge
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Hephaestus God Forges begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: Hephaestus God Forge
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Hephaestus God Forges are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Chosen Hephaestus God Forge
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Young Loki Flame Aspect

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.name: Rising Loki Flame Aspect
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Loki Flame Aspects begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.name: Loki Flame Aspect
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Loki Flame Aspects are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.name: Emerging Frigg Veil
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Frigg Veils begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Frigg Veil

base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Frigg Veils are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: Fledgling Fenrir Chain-Break
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Fenrir Chain-Break. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Fenrir Chain-Break is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: Nascent Fenrir Chain-Break
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Fenrir Chain-Breaks begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Fenrir Chain-Break
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Fenrir Chain-Breaks are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Chosen Fenrir Chain-Break
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Fledgling Hel Death Aspect
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Hel Death Aspect. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Hel Death Aspect is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: First-Form Hel Death Aspect
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Hel Death Aspects begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Hel Death Aspect
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Hel Death Aspects are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: Exalted Hel Death Aspect
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

star_6.name: Sleipnir Champion the Revered

star_7.name: Eternal Sleipnir Champion

base_chain.name: Fledgling Sleipnir Champion
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Sleipnir Champion. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Sleipnir Champion is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Rising Sleipnir Champion
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Sleipnir Champions begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Sleipnir Champion
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Sleipnir Champions are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: Exalted Sleipnir Champion
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Bud Geri Wolf
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Geri Wolf. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Geri Wolf is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: First-Form Geri Wolf
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Geri Wolfs begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Geri Wolf
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Geri Wolfs are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: Exalted Geri Wolf
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Nascent Draug Sea Lord

base_chain.lore: Awakened Draug Sea Lords begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Draug Sea Lord

base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Draug Sea Lords are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. base_chain.name: Pup Ymir Primordial
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Ymir Primordial. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Ymir Primordial is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Rising Ymir Primordial
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Ymir Primordials begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Ymir Primordial
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Ymir Primordials are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Ascendant Ymir Primordial
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Ragnarök Fire at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Ragnarök Fire has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Pup Ragnarök Fire
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Ragnarök Fire. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Ragnarök Fire is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: Rising Ragnarök Fire
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Ragnarök Fires begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

base_chain.name: Ragnarök Fire
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Ragnarök Fires are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Crowned Ragnarök Fire
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Titan Born path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.

star_5.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

star_6.name: Níðhöggr Gnawing Incarnate
star_6.appearance: Níðhöggr Gnawing defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Níðhöggr Gnawings have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

star_7.name: Origin Níðhöggr Gnawing
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Níðhöggr Gnawing is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Níðhöggr Gnawing is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Fafnir Dragon
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Fafnir Dragon. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Fafnir Dragon is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Emerging Fafnir Dragon
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Fafnir Dragons begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Fafnir Dragon
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Fafnir Dragons are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Hallowed Fafnir Dragon
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.

star_8.name: Norn Thread II: Eternal Throne

star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.

star_8.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: Echo Norn Thread II
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Norn Thread II. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Norn Thread II is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

base_chain.name: Rising Norn Thread II
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Norn Thread IIs begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Norn Thread II
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Norn Thread IIs are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Chosen Norn Thread II
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Fledgling Verðandi Weave

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.name: Kindling Verðandi Weave
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Verðandi Weaves begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: Verðandi Weave
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Verðandi Weaves are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.name: Marked Verðandi Weave
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.

base_chain.name: Bud Bifrost Walker
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Bifrost Walker. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Bifrost Walker is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Rising Bifrost Walker
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Bifrost Walkers begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Bifrost Walker
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Bifrost Walkers are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Marked Bifrost Walker
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

star_5.name: Bifrost Guardian — Titan Born Sovereign

star_6.name: Bifrost Guardian the Revered

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Bifrost Guardians have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

star_7.name: Origin Bifrost Guardian

base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Dark Elf Shadow is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: Awakened Dark Elf Shadow
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Dark Elf Shadows begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Dark Elf Shadow
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Dark Elf Shadows are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Chosen Dark Elf Shadow
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

star_5.name: Light Elf Glow — Titan Born Warlord
star_5.appearance: The Titan Born path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Titan Born path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Light Elf Glows are landmarks. Myth Eternal merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

star_6.name: Light Elf Glow the Unbroken
star_6.appearance: Light Elf Glow defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Light Elf Glows have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

star_7.name: Primordial Light Elf Glow
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Light Elf Glow is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Light Elf Glow is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

star_8.name: Light Elf Glow: The Living Myth
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Light Elf Glow at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Light Elf Glow has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.

base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Vali Vengeances are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Forsaken Vali Vengeance
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

star_5.name: Forseti Justice — Titan Born Baron
star_5.appearance: The Titan Born path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Titan Born path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Forseti Justices are landmarks. Myth Eternal merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

star_6.name: Forseti Justice the Eternal
star_6.appearance: Forseti Justice defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Forseti Justices have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

star_7.name: World-Ender Forseti Justice
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Forseti Justice is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Forseti Justice is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

star_8.name: Forseti Justice: Eternal Throne
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Forseti Justice at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Forseti Justice has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

star_5.name: Surtr World Flame — Titan Born Lord
star_5.appearance: The Titan Born path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Titan Born path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Surtr World Flames are landmarks. Myth Eternal merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

star_6.name: Surtr World Flame Incarnate
star_6.appearance: Surtr World Flame defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Surtr World Flames have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

star_7.name: Last Surtr World Flame
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Surtr World Flame is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Surtr World Flame is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

star_8.name: Surtr World Flame: Eternal Throne
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Surtr World Flame at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Surtr World Flame has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: Spawn Isis Healer
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Isis Healer. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Isis Healer is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.name: Nascent Isis Healer
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Isis Healers begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: Isis Healer
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Isis Healers are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

base_chain.name: Marked Isis Healer
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Pup Anubis Guide
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Anubis Guide. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Anubis Guide is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Emerging Anubis Guide
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Anubis Guides begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Anubis Guide
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Anubis Guides are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Branded Anubis Guide
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

star_8.name: Anubis Scale Bearer: Axis of the Age

star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Anubis Scale Bearer has never been fully documented. star_8.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Lesser Anubis Scale Bearer
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Anubis Scale Bearer. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Anubis Scale Bearer is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Nascent Anubis Scale Bearer
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Anubis Scale Bearers begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Anubis Scale Bearer
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Anubis Scale Bearers are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Hallowed Anubis Scale Bearer
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

star_5.name: Anubis Lord — Titan Born Champion

star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Titan Born path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.

star_5.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Fledgling Thoth Scribe
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Thoth Scribe. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Thoth Scribe is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: Awakened Thoth Scribe
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Thoth Scribes begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Thoth Scribe
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Thoth Scribes are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Chosen Thoth Scribe
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: Newborn Bastet Kitten
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Bastet Kitten. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Bastet Kitten is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: First-Form Bastet Kitten
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Bastet Kittens begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Bastet Kitten
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Bastet Kittens are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Crowned Bastet Kitten
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Titan Born path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.

star_5.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

star_6.name: Bastet Warrior the Boundless
star_6.appearance: Bastet Warrior defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Bastet Warriors have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

star_7.name: Eternal Bastet Warrior
