base_chain.name: Wisp Sekhmet Rage
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Sekhmet Rage. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Sekhmet Rage is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Nascent Sekhmet Rage
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Sekhmet Rages begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Sekhmet Rage
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Sekhmet Rages are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Branded Sekhmet Rage
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Emerging Hathor Love Goddess

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.

base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Hathor Love Goddess

base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Hallowed Hathor Love Goddess

star_5.name: Ptah Creator — Titan Born Baron

star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Titan Born path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.

star_5.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

star_6.name: Ptah Creator the Transcendent
star_6.appearance: Ptah Creator defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Ptah Creators have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

star_7.name: World-Ender Ptah Creator
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Ptah Creator is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Ptah Creator is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

star_8.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Bud Apophis Coil
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Apophis Coil. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Apophis Coil is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Stirring Apophis Coil
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Apophis Coils begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Apophis Coil
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Apophis Coils are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Exalted Apophis Coil
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Origin God path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.

star_5.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

star_6.name: Sphinx Guardian the Feared
star_6.appearance: Sphinx Guardian defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Sphinx Guardians have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

star_7.name: Final Sphinx Guardian
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Sphinx Guardian is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Sphinx Guardian is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

star_8.name: Sphinx Guardian: Eternal Throne
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Sphinx Guardian at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Sphinx Guardian has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Lesser Sphinx Guardian
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Sphinx Guardian. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Sphinx Guardian is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Rising Sphinx Guardian
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Sphinx Guardians begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Sphinx Guardian
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Sphinx Guardians are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Marked Sphinx Guardian
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Spawn Maat Balance
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Maat Balance. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Maat Balance is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Stirring Maat Balance
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Maat Balances begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Maat Balance
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Maat Balances are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.name: Chosen Maat Balance
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: Onuris Hunter

base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.

base_chain.name: Seshat Record

base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Seshat Records are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Hallowed Seshat Record
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Seker Silences have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

star_7.name: Absolute Seker Silence
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Seker Silence is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Seker Silence is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

base_chain.name: Echo Seker Silence
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Seker Silence. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Seker Silence is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Kindling Seker Silence
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Seker Silences begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Seker Silence
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Seker Silences are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Hallowed Seker Silence
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Duat Guardians are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Exalted Duat Guardian
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

star_5.name: Field of Reeds Echo — Titan Born Baron
star_5.appearance: The Titan Born path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Titan Born path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Field of Reeds Echos are landmarks. Myth Eternal merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

star_6.name: Field of Reeds Echo the True
star_6.appearance: Field of Reeds Echo defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Field of Reeds Echos have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

star_7.name: World-Ender Field of Reeds Echo
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Field of Reeds Echo is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Field of Reeds Echo is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

star_8.name: Field of Reeds Echo: World-Soul
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Field of Reeds Echo at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Field of Reeds Echo has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

star_6.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Emerging Surya Sun

base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Surya Suns are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

star_6.name: Naga King the Absolute
star_6.appearance: Naga King defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Naga Kings have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

star_7.name: Last Naga King

base_chain.name: Young Naga King
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Naga King. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Naga King is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Emerging Naga King
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Naga Kings begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

base_chain.name: Naga King
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Naga Kings are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: Branded Naga King
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Emerging Shesha Eternal
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Shesha Eternals begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Shesha Eternal
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Shesha Eternals are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Marked Shesha Eternal
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

star_6.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Pup Gandharva Elder
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Gandharva Elder. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Gandharva Elder is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Nascent Gandharva Elder
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Gandharva Elders begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Gandharva Elder
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Gandharva Elders are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Forsaken Gandharva Elder
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Origin God path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Apsara Elders are landmarks. Myth Eternal merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. star_5.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

star_6.name: Apsara Elder Incarnate
star_6.appearance: Apsara Elder defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Apsara Elders have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

star_7.name: Origin Apsara Elder
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Apsara Elder is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Apsara Elder is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

star_8.name: Apsara Elder: World-Shaper
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Apsara Elder at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Apsara Elder has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Wisp Apsara Elder
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Apsara Elder. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Apsara Elder is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Awakened Apsara Elder
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Apsara Elders begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Apsara Elder
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Apsara Elders are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Forsaken Apsara Elder
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.name: Lesser Yakshini Forest
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Yakshini Forest. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Yakshini Forest is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.

base_chain.name: Awakened Yakshini Forest
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Yakshini Forests begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Yakshini Forest
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Yakshini Forests are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Marked Yakshini Forest
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Kurma Tortoise

star_8.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Echo Churning Serpent
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Churning Serpent. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Churning Serpent is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Stirring Churning Serpent
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Churning Serpents begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: Pup Airavata Elephant
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Airavata Elephant. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Airavata Elephant is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.

base_chain.name: Stirring Airavata Elephant
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Airavata Elephants begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: Airavata Elephant
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Airavata Elephants are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Branded Airavata Elephant
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.name: Rising Pinaka Bow
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Pinaka Bows begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Pinaka Bow
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Pinaka Bows are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: Forsaken Pinaka Bow
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.name: Lesser Pancha Bhuta Air
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Pancha Bhuta Air. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Pancha Bhuta Air is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.name: Stirring Pancha Bhuta Air
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Pancha Bhuta Airs begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Pancha Bhuta Air
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Pancha Bhuta Airs are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Exalted Pancha Bhuta Air
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.

base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. base_chain.name: Lesser Hiranyaksha
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Hiranyaksha. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.name: Awakened Hiranyaksha
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Hiranyakshas begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Hiranyaksha
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Hiranyakshas are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.name: Hallowed Hiranyaksha
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Kartikeya Wars begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Kartikeya War
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Kartikeya Wars are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. base_chain.name: Fledgling Pralaya End
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Pralaya End. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Pralaya End is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

base_chain.name: Kindling Pralaya End
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Pralaya Ends begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Pralaya End
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Pralaya Ends are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Hallowed Pralaya End
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Wisp Dragon King Carp
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Dragon King Carp. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Dragon King Carp is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: First-Form Dragon King Carp
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Dragon King Carps begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Dragon King Carp
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Dragon King Carps are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Branded Dragon King Carp
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: Rising Jade Emperor Envoy
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.

base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Jade Emperor Prime is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Emerging Jade Emperor Prime
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Jade Emperor Primes begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Jade Emperor Prime
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Jade Emperor Primes are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Chosen Jade Emperor Prime
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

star_5.name: Heavenly Court Guard — Titan Born Warlord
star_5.appearance: The Titan Born path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Titan Born path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Heavenly Court Guards are landmarks. Myth Eternal merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

star_6.name: Heavenly Court Guard the Feared
star_6.appearance: Heavenly Court Guard defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Heavenly Court Guards have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

star_7.name: Primordial Heavenly Court Guard
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Heavenly Court Guard is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Heavenly Court Guard is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

star_8.name: Heavenly Court Guard: The Undying
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Heavenly Court Guard at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Heavenly Court Guard has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks
