base_chain.name: Awakened Origami Spirit
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Origami Spirits begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: Origami Spirit
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Origami Spirits are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

base_chain.name: Exalted Origami Spirit
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Wisp Susanoo Tempest
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Susanoo Tempest. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Susanoo Tempest is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: First-Form Susanoo Tempest
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Susanoo Tempests begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.name: Susanoo Tempest
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Susanoo Tempests are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Crowned Susanoo Tempest
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Seed Leprechaun Trickster
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Leprechaun Trickster. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Leprechaun Trickster is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: Awakened Leprechaun Trickster
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Leprechaun Tricksters begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Leprechaun Trickster
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Leprechaun Tricksters are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Forsaken Leprechaun Trickster
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

star_6.name: Pooka Wild the Revered

star_7.name: Apex Pooka Wild

star_8.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Pup Pooka Wild
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Pooka Wild. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Pooka Wild is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: Stirring Pooka Wild
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Pooka Wilds begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.name: Pooka Wild

base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.

base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Selkie Sea Form

base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.

base_chain.name: Spawn Dullahan Rider
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Dullahan Rider. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Dullahan Rider is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Emerging Dullahan Rider
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Dullahan Riders begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Dullahan Rider
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Dullahan Riders are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Chosen Dullahan Rider
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: First-Form Tuatha Dé Danann
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Tuatha Dé Dananns begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Tuatha Dé Danann
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Tuatha Dé Dananns are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: Crowned Tuatha Dé Danann

base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.

base_chain.name: Bud Green Man Ancient

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.name: First-Form Green Man Ancient
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Green Man Ancients begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Green Man Ancient

base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.

base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Exalted Green Man Ancient
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. base_chain.name: Lesser Will-o'-Wisp
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Will-o'-Wisp. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Will-o'-Wisp is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Awakened Will-o'-Wisp
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Will-o'-Wisps begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Will-o'-Wisp
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Will-o'-Wisps are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Marked Will-o'-Wisp
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Lughnasadh Harvest is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.

base_chain.name: Rising Lughnasadh Harvest
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Lughnasadh Harvests begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Lughnasadh Harvest
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Lughnasadh Harvests are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Branded Lughnasadh Harvest
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

star_6.name: Druid Elder the Transcendent
star_6.appearance: Druid Elder defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.

base_chain.name: Pup Druid Elder
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Druid Elder. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Druid Elder is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: Emerging Druid Elder
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Druid Elders begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Druid Elder
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Druid Elders are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Ascendant Druid Elder
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Bards of Morrigan is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Rising Bards of Morrigan
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Bards of Morrigans begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Bards of Morrigan
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Bards of Morrigans are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Branded Bards of Morrigan
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

star_5.name: Tara Hill Spirit — Titan Born Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Titan Born path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Titan Born path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Tara Hill Spirits are landmarks. Myth Eternal merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

star_6.name: Tara Hill Spirit the Revered
star_6.appearance: Tara Hill Spirit defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Tara Hill Spirits have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

star_7.name: Origin Tara Hill Spirit
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Tara Hill Spirit is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Tara Hill Spirit is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Tara Hill Spirit at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Tara Hill Spirit has never been fully documented. base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

star_5.name: Cernunnos God — Titan Born Champion
star_5.appearance: The Titan Born path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Titan Born path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Cernunnos Gods are landmarks. Myth Eternal merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

star_6.name: Cernunnos God the Ancient
star_6.appearance: Cernunnos God defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Cernunnos Gods have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

star_7.name: Final Cernunnos God
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Cernunnos God is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Cernunnos God is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

star_8.name: Cernunnos God: Axis of the Age
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Cernunnos God at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Cernunnos God has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.

base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Hallowed Ishtar Ascent
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Stirring Nergal Plague

base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Origin God path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Lamassu Guardians are landmarks. Myth Eternal merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

star_6.name: Lamassu Guardian of the Apex
star_6.appearance: Lamassu Guardian defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Lamassu Guardians have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

star_7.name: Last Lamassu Guardian
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Lamassu Guardian is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Lamassu Guardian is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

star_8.name: Lamassu Guardian: First and Last
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Lamassu Guardian at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Lamassu Guardian has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Echo Lamassu Guardian
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Lamassu Guardian. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Lamassu Guardian is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.name: First-Form Lamassu Guardian
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Lamassu Guardians begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: Lamassu Guardian
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Lamassu Guardians are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

base_chain.name: Exalted Lamassu Guardian
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Lesser Ereshkigal Death Queen
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Ereshkigal Death Queen. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Ereshkigal Death Queen is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Kindling Ereshkigal Death Queen
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Ereshkigal Death Queens begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Ereshkigal Death Queen
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Ereshkigal Death Queens are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Exalted Ereshkigal Death Queen
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Shamash Suns have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

star_7.name: World-Ender Shamash Sun

star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.

star_7.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

star_8.name: Shamash Sun: First and Last

star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Shamash Sun has never been fully documented. star_8.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: Fledgling Shamash Sun
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Shamash Sun. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Shamash Sun is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Kindling Shamash Sun
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Shamash Suns begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Shamash Sun

base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.

base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: Marked Shamash Sun
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. base_chain.name: Spawn Zu Tablet Thief
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Zu Tablet Thief. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Zu Tablet Thief is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Stirring Zu Tablet Thief
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Zu Tablet Thiefs begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Zu Tablet Thief
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Zu Tablet Thiefs are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Marked Zu Tablet Thief
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

star_6.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

star_7.name: Origin Quetzalcoatl Serpent

star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.

star_8.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Young Quetzalcoatl Serpent
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Quetzalcoatl Serpent. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Quetzalcoatl Serpent is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Awakened Quetzalcoatl Serpent
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Quetzalcoatl Serpents begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Quetzalcoatl Serpent
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.

base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Forsaken Quetzalcoatl Serpent
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.name: Kindling Coatlicue Serpent Skirt

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Coatlicue Serpent Skirts begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Coatlicue Serpent Skirts are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.

base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

star_5.name: Pachamama Earth — Titan Born Lord
star_5.appearance: The Titan Born path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Titan Born path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Pachamama Earths are landmarks. Myth Eternal merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

star_6.name: Pachamama Earth the Boundless
star_6.appearance: Pachamama Earth defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Pachamama Earths have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

star_7.name: Final Pachamama Earth
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Pachamama Earth is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Pachamama Earth is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

star_8.name: Pachamama Earth: God-Form
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Pachamama Earth at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Pachamama Earth has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. base_chain.name: Fledgling Veles Underworld
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Veles Underworld. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Veles Underworld is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.name: Kindling Veles Underworld
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Veles Underworlds begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: Veles Underworld
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Veles Underworlds are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Hallowed Veles Underworld
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Stirring Dazbog Sun

base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Dazbog Suns are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.name: Kindling Rusalka Shore
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Rusalka Shores begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Rusalka Shore
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class Rusalka Shores are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.

star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of World Mythology Prime has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

star_5.name: World Mythology Prime — Myth Ascendant Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Myth Ascendant path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Myth Ascendant path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class World Mythology Primes are landmarks. Myth Eternal merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

star_6.name: World Mythology Prime the Ancient
star_6.appearance: World Mythology Prime defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent World Mythology Primes have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

star_7.name: Primordial World Mythology Prime
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of World Mythology Prime is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of World Mythology Prime is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "Before the First Word". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

evolution_req.special: Complete "Before the First Word" story quest

base_chain.name: Fledgling World Mythology Prime
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of World Mythology Prime. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of World Mythology Prime is found only in the most sheltered corners of Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Awakened World Mythology Prime
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened World Mythology Primes begin staking small territory within Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: World Mythology Prime
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Myth Eternal, Champion-class World Mythology Primes are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.name: Exalted World Mythology Prime
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Titan Born — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Titan Born path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle
